{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Initial shape:", df.shape)
print("Columns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("Data types:\n", df.dtypes)
print("Missing values:\n", df.isnull().sum())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("First few revenue values:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA order IDs:", qa_orders['order_id'].tolist())

# Check status
print("Unique values in status:", df['status'].unique())

# Check channel and customer_segment
print("Channel distribution:\n", df['channel'].value_counts())
print("Customer segment distribution:\n", df['customer_segment'].value_counts())"}
